title: 游戏世界是破碎的，可以随意对接他人船只、卸载燃料箱而不受惩罚。
description: 游戏世界是破碎的，可以随意对接他人船只、卸载燃料箱而不受惩罚。
evidence: Even in the KitFox advert they show that the entire game world is broken. You can just dock to people's ships, uninstall their fuel tanks and haul them back on your ship and nobody bats an eye.
